body:
I've been searching on this problem and I came up with some answers :
First, the problem is more about the dpi of the screen and the size of each pixels physically because, since the line is always 1 pixel wide, when a pixel becomes very small it can be very difficult to see the line. So to solve this problem, the lines should be scaled with the editor UI scaling.
However, currently solving this problem by scaling the line is a bit difficult because of the way they are drawn. Currently, the lines are drawn in the `TileAtlasView::_draw_base_tiles_shape_grid` function which uses the `draw_tile_shape` function. The `draw_tile_shape` function uses meshes which seems to be pretty hard to modify and thus without knowing how they work in details it would be hard to scale them with the UI Editor Scale.
Moreover, it seems to be possible to fix this problem because some lines for the selection of the grid are bit bigger and scale nicely with the `viewport` zoom.
Finally, this problem is also way more visible in Isometric and Hexagon tile shape then in Square and Half Offset Square tile shape due to the fact that in the two more visible modes the lines are on the white grid lines and thus the color is never transparent and always more visible. Note that it can also be seen with unconventional tile size that would make the tile shape not on the tiles grid.
Finally, changing the color and the transparency of the line in `Editor settings -> Editor -> Tiles Editor -> Grid Color` can make the line much more visible and can can partially solve the problem for the moment.
